description: Read an image or video task: status (queued, in_progress, completed, failed), progress, result_urls and fail_reason. Free. wait_seconds (0-45, default 30) keeps polling until the task finishes or the time runs out. Failed tasks are refunded automatically. Result links last 24 hours.

task_id.description: task_id returned by generate_image or generate_video.

name: get_task
title: Get task status and results
